description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Cancel the licence issued to the standard Credit Finance Limited and not permitted to carry on Finance business with effect from 25th July, 2018
reasoning: This gazette content announces the cancellation of a finance business license under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011. It constitutes a regulatory action by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content focuses on regulatory compliance and enforcement of financial legislation, which falls squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
